name: Bitwarden
summary: A free password app that saves and fills in your passwords on every device.
gains: Unlimited passwords on unlimited devices for free
tradeoffs: Interface is a bit plainer than 1Password
Some extras (file attachments, 2FA codes) need the cheap premium tier
setupSteps: Create a free Bitwarden account with a strong master password
In Bitwarden go to Tools → Import and choose 1Password
Install the browser extension and phone app
Delete the export file once imported
freeTierLimits: Free plan: unlimited passwords and devices.
